items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: she says, 'I'd like for you to be my pianist and arranger... I'll pay you for each arrangement you make'

ctx.x: So when Lena heard Xavier Cugat's band was gonna play for her, she said, 'Hom, I don't know if this is gonna be -- we called each other Hom, you know, that was a little slang expression.' 'I don't know if this is gonna work or not.' She says, 'Why don't you go ahead and get a small group together to back me,' you know. So I went ahead and went to New York, and you know, the personnel that I got -- do you wanna hear it?
